svg.title: Atome LM: model and three-pathway block architecture
svg.desc: Byte tokens pass through embedding, N residual blocks, final LayerNorm and unembedding to produce logits. Each block normalizes its input and computes Local causal convolution, State diagonal SSM and Sparse top-k causal attention. A ternary linear router followed by softmax weights all three outputs. Their weighted sum is added to the original input. Based on TilelliLab atome-lm PAPER.ja.md sections 2 to 5.

g.text: Byte-level language model with three complementary pathways per block
Solid arrows: activations / outputs Dashed arrow: router weights
Per-channel a, b, c / hidden state
No positional embeddings / No dense FFN / Not a multi-bank MoE
Paper defaults: d_model=64, N=4, d_head=16, vocabulary=256, kernel=5
This workspace (944K): d_model=256, N=8, d_head=64, attention top-k=4
Source: TilelliLab/atome-lm, PAPER.ja.md, sections 2-5 / Diagram redrawn from the architecture description
